- Read fresh. Filed on the maintainer's ruling `6508997538` (#27491 item 5). The example app is graded with the subsystem it exercises, which is the dashboard and nav audience.

director#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CavdFhhfMVhuGjp7tP

Ruling: the CRM Pipeline entry's audience gate, after the measured cost of a declared capability (project discussion thread 「决定仪表盘全部无权限时的显示」, follow-up to #27491 ruling `6508997538` item 5) · letter **G** · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-30T01:36Z

The maintainer's own ruling, given in the project thread at 2026-10-30T01:34Z on the review thread's six-section brief and its post-measurement addendum (`/mnt/project-files/decisions/27735-种子管理员失去Pipeline-呈批.md`, recommendation G). Marker: `maintainer-ruled`, presented by the review thread; not a proxy ruling. It amends the MECHANISM of #27491 ruling `6508997538` item 5; that item's intent (a member who cannot read the Pipeline's data is not offered it) stands.

## What was measured and re-verified

- PR #27805 at `87e10674` (declared capability `crm.view_pipeline`, granted to `crm_sales_user`, required on `pipeline_dashboard` and `nav_pipeline_dashboard`). The card thread ran `packages/qa/dogfood/test/install-local-unmanaged-mode.dogfood.test.ts` against it: **11 failed / 9 passed**; the control (the CRM at the merge-base, same build) 20/20. PR CI was green only because the dogfood shards were skipped on the PR.
- 10 failures: a stack-level `capabilities` declaration makes the CRM package refuse an UNMANAGED install, 422 `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_UNCOPYABLE`. By design: the `capability` metadata type is `allowRuntimeCreate: false` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts` L1242, ADR-0131 D3 / ADR-0066 D1: a capability lives in the registry and is never an environment row), and the unmanaged import refuses whole any body carrying a runtime-uncreatable type (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-unmanaged-install.ts` L33). The dogfood uses the CRM as its unmanaged-install specimen. A package that declares capabilities cannot be installed unmanaged; this card does not change that.
- 1 failure (L460): the seeded admin's `GET /meta/dashboard/pipeline_dashboard` answers 403 `audience-permission`. `holdsRequiredPermissions` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` L753) has no administrator bypass; the dashboard arm (L1690–1700) judges the audience gate before `policy.arms`, author or not, so the gate also closes the dashboard in Studio for a caller who lacks the capability. The seeded admin holds `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES` (`eval-user.zod.ts` L115): every platform capability, no app-declared one (`system/dev-login.zod.ts` L14–27 documents this as by construction).
- Granting without declaring is not a way out: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` L875–906, organization boundary condition (c): a `systemPermissions` name that is not a capability declared `scope: 'org'` puts the set outside the boundary, so an organization administrator could no longer assign `crm_sales_user` or the three sales positions that distribute it (ADR-0090 D12).
- The nav guard already binds `current_user.can(object, verb)` from the member's permissions payload (objectui#4421; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavMemberGates.ts`, `ExpressionProvider.tsx`), and `BaseNavItemSchema.visible` is a CEL predicate. `opportunity_metrics` is bound to `crm_opportunity` (`examples/app-crm/src/datasets/opportunity.dataset.ts` L17), the object whose read refusal is the six tiles' 403. `visible` is not judged by the server's read gate (`meta-item-read-gate.ts` L918), so the dogfood's admin reads are untouched.

## Governing text

- ADR-0066 D4: "`visibleWhen` hides, `requiredPermissions` refuses." This card's need is HIDE (the entry is not offered); the enforcement is the dataset query's 403, already in place and unchanged.
- #27491 ruling `6508997538` item 5 (intent: a member without a sales set is not offered the Pipeline; a sales user is) — mechanism amended here.
- ADR-0131 D3 / ADR-0066 D1 (a capability is a registry declaration) and the unmanaged-install rule (`package-unmanaged-install.ts`): fixed inputs.
- ADR-0090 D12 condition (c): fixed input.

## The ruling: G

The CRM example hides the Pipeline entry from a member who cannot read opportunities with a visibility predicate on the navigation item. No capability is declared or granted, and the dashboard itself carries no `requiredPermissions`.

Fixed here:

1. `examples/app-crm/src/apps/crm.app.ts`, `nav_pipeline_dashboard`: add `visible: "current_user.can('crm_opportunity', 'read')"`. Nothing else on the entry changes.
2. PR #27805 reverts its other changes: `src/security/capabilities.ts` (delete), `src/security/index.ts`, `objectstack.config.ts` (`capabilities`), `src/security/sales-positions.ts` (`systemPermissions`), `src/dashboards/pipeline.dashboard.ts` (`requiredPermissions`).
3. `examples/app-crm/test/pipeline-audience.test.ts` pins two things, read off the parsed stack: the Pipeline nav entry carries a `visible` predicate of the form `current_user.can('<object>', 'read')`, and that `<object>` equals the `object` of the dataset every `pipeline_dashboard` widget reads. The capability-centred cases are retired with the capability.
4. Acceptance for #27735 reads: a member who cannot read `crm_opportunity` sees no Pipeline entry in the CRM sidebar; a sales user and the seeded administrator see it as today; a direct link for the refused member shows the #27491 no-access panel (PR #27777), not a blank. The earlier "direct link gets `dashboard-access-denied`" acceptance is withdrawn.
5. Verification before push: the `example-crm` package tests, and `install-local-unmanaged-mode.dogfood.test.ts` run locally once more, expected back to 20/20; both recorded in the PR body.
6. ⛔ Not: a declared capability on the CRM stack (A — makes the package un-installable unmanaged); a grant with no declaration (A′ — condition (c)); a platform administrator bypass in `holdsRequiredPermissions` (D — changes ADR-0066's meaning); `demoStaff` / `devLogins` for this card (not needed under G; the seeded admin keeps the entry); any change under `packages/qa/dogfood`.

### Why G, on the four axes (business standpoint)

- **① Long-term soundness (≥50%).** The platform has two keys for two jobs, and this card's job is the hide. Using the refuse key cost the example its unmanaged installability and closed the dashboard to its own author in Studio; the hide key costs nothing the platform has not already paid for `type: 'object'` entries (objectui#12109 prunes those on the same payload). The data refusal stays the one enforcement.
- **② Measured business pull.** The 18.3.0 RC walkthrough member (#27377 W3-UX) sees the landing say nothing is available while the sidebar offers Pipeline; G closes that gap for every member without opportunity read.
- **③ AI-error prevention.** G's failure direction: a frame with no permissions payload withholds the entry and reports once (objectui#12700), never shows it to everyone; a wrong object name in the predicate is caught by the new pin against the dataset's `object`. A and A′ failed loud too, but in a required CI gate that the PR's own CI had skipped.
- **④ Startup no-sprawl.** Two files in `examples/app-crm`, S. A was M across `packages/qa`; C left the inconsistency in place.

Only-① pick: G. Do ②③④ flip it: no. Effort for the chosen letter: **S**.

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
① 长远：藏用 `visible`、拒用 `requiredPermissions`（ADR-0066 D4 原话），本卡要的是藏；声明能力让 CRM 不能非托管安装、作者在 Studio 也打不开，代价不是这张卡该付的；对象类导航条目早已按同一权限载荷裁剪（objectui#12109）。
② 拉动：RC 走查成员（#27377 W3-UX）首页说没东西、侧栏却挂 Pipeline；G 对每个读不到机会的成员都关上这个口。
③ 防错：无权限载荷的框架按 objectui#12700 收起条目不报错；谓词里的对象名由新钉对照数据集 `object`；A/A′ 的红出现在 PR CI 跳过的必需门里，是 dogfood 实跑才看见的。
④ 不扩散：两个文件，S；A 要跨 `packages/qa` 换样本（M）；C 留着不一致。
Prior rulings read: #27491 `6508997538` item 5（本裁修订其机制）、ADR-0066 D1/D4、ADR-0131 D3、ADR-0090 D12 条件 (c)、objectui#4421 / #12109 / #12700、hotclm#28 D（demoStaff，本裁不用）；实测：卡线程 dogfood 11/9 与对照 20/20。

## Execution after the ruling

- The card stays `pm:dispatched` on `domain:ui#2`; the card thread amends PR #27805 per items 1–5 with `Ruling-ref: <this comment id>`, retitles the PR, keeps `Fixes #27735`, then gates, os-dev-report and the seat's ACCEPT + PASS flow. Non-governed surface.
- The review thread adds one note under #27491 `6508997538`: item 5's mechanism is now this ruling's `visible` predicate; the all-refused panel (PR #27777) is unchanged.
- Not reopened: the capability type's `allowRuntimeCreate: false`; the unmanaged-install refusal; `holdsRequiredPermissions`; the organization boundary; the #27491 panel.
